chunks: Aban, from Abdul Rahman, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said:
The ram in your land is superior to the camel.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: Superior or better, indicating a recommendation or preference in fiqh.
key_terms.الْجَزُورُ: The camel, another major type of sacrificial animal in Islamic tradition.
key_terms.الْكَبْشُ: The ram (male sheep), a common sacrificial animal.

ai.seo_question: Which animal is preferred for sacrifice according to this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the preference for the ram over the camel is established, reflecting the practical realities of the Arabian Peninsula where sheep were more accessible and easier to manage for the average believer. This hadith is foundational in Shia fiqh for determining the 'best' (afdal) sacrificial animal, balancing religious merit with local economic and logistical conditions. It underscores the principle that while all valid animals are permissible, selecting the one that best facilitates the act of worship is spiritually preferred.
